note: Fast output synapses run inside every training window (EventLM._plastic_window) and, in a stream, the same rule in whole numbers (EventLM._teach with plastic_after). Test bed: the stack of results/event_lm/stream_form/small_test_bed.json (6 levels, 256 channels, 4.86 million parameters, windows of 256 bytes, batch 16, 6,000 updates on a CPU, seed 20001, rate 3e-4, averaged weights). Scored on the enwik8 validation split as 16 streams of about 312 KB with experiments/eval_stream.py, paired over pieces with experiments/compare_stream_scores.py and experiments/stream_quarters.py. One seed per arm.

criteria.replaces: The first prompt's go/no-go: c or d beats b by more than b's own gain over a, and f does not gain. That bar was set to b's gain on this small stack (0.0945), about 14 times v15's full-size gain, so it measured how weak the small stack is rather than whether training helps.
criteria.comparison: Validation streams of the test-bed scorings: 16 streams of about 312 KB, a lead of 8,192 and the same pieces. Every comparison paired with experiments/compare_stream_scores.py. References: a, the stack with no fast synapses; b, the stack with v15's teach given after training, the strongest reading-time learner that needs no training (the stronger of b-all and b-last); a candidate is any arm trained with plasticity in the loop, scored with its own trained rule (the decay arms already running and the arms of the revised prompt: Rule B with C = 16 and C = 64, N, A-carry).
go_if_a_candidate_meets_all: 1. Better than b: it beats b by more than the paired 95% interval and by at least 0.010 bpb.

2. Stable along the stream: no quarter of the stream scores worse than a in that quarter; the gain over a in the last quarter is at least 0.8 times the gain in the first quarter; and on one long stream (a lead of 262,144 bytes, or one stream of 1 MB or more) it is still better than b.
3. The control fails: the same arm with the stored values shuffled gains less than a fifth of the candidate's gain over a. Run for every arm that passes 1 and 2.
criteria.second_route: If no candidate passes, but the trained cells scored with v15's teach beat b by more than the interval and by at least 0.010, and are stable as in criterion 2: GO with that setting (train with plasticity in the loop, run v15's rule at inference), reported as that.
criteria.no_go: Otherwise. Write up the null result with the table and do not move to full size. After the results are in, add no arms beyond those named.
always_report: every arm scored with its rule switched off (the dependence check; not a criterion)
the gain by quarter for every arm
the in-window gains beside the stream gains
analysis_rules_given_with_the_criteria: Judge 'are the trained cells worse for v15's rule' by the gain, not the score: each trained stack's rule-off score minus its score with v15's teach, against the baseline's gain from teach (b over a). Near that gain: the cells are fine and the loss is in the base. Clearly smaller: the cells serve the rule worse.
v15's teach threshold was tuned on untrained cells. Re-pick it per arm on the first part of the validation streams, as v15 picked its own, before comparing teach scores across arms.

The shuffled control's teach score: also worse than the baseline means the damage comes from training with any plastic readout in the loop; as good as the baseline means it is specific to learning to use real memory.
Compare the 65,536-byte lead with the 8,192 lead for v15's rule and the trained rules: a gain that shrinks with the longer lead means the rule adapts rather than accumulates.

seen_before_recording.analyses: experiments/stream_quarters.py at the 8,192 lead against a, b-all and b-last for b-all, b-last, c, e8, f and g (gains and quarters).
seen_before_recording.training_logs: In-window averaged validation of every arm at every evaluation; d up to 4,500 of 6,000 updates.

readings_recorded_before_the_long_stream.criterion_1: 'Beats b by more than the paired 95% interval and by at least 0.010': the lower end of the paired interval of b less the setting is above zero, and the difference itself is at least 0.010.
readings_recorded_before_the_long_stream.criterion_2_long_stream: 'Still better than b on one long stream': the setting and b scored on the validation split as 16 streams with a lead of 262,144 bytes (every byte still scored once; each stream after the first hears 262,144 bytes before its scored part); the lower end of the paired interval of b less the setting is above zero.
readings_recorded_before_the_long_stream.state_at_recording: Second route: e10's cells with v15's rule on levels 0-5 at 2^22 pass criterion 1 (+0.0130 [+0.0122, +0.0138]) and the quarter tests of criterion 2 (gains over a of +0.160, +0.134, +0.130, +0.178). Their long-stream scoring and b's are running and unseen. B16's (+0.0096), B64's (+0.0087), e8's (+0.0088) and c's (+0.0083) cells fail criterion 1; d's and carry's are scoring.

B16, level 5, rule off.chosen: 2^26 if the last level is better

B64, level 5, rule off.chosen: 2^26 if the last level is better

teach_thresholds.all_levels_note: The all-level scans of the trained cells first covered 2^22 to 2^27; their best lay at the edge, 2^22, so 2^21 was added for every arm (03:05 UTC), which bracketed it. The setting of each arm is the better of its last-level and all-level best on the first million: all levels at 2^22 for a (that is b), c, e8, e10 and f.
teach_thresholds.seen_before_choosing_all_levels: These first-million scans, and the full-split scores of b-all at 2^22 (1.81412), b-last at 2^25 (1.84552), and the last-level teach of c, e8 and e10 at 2^26 (1.81373, 1.81717, 1.80983) and f at 2^25 (1.84107). No full-split all-level teach score of trained cells existed.
teach_thresholds.new_arms_note: B16 and B64: last level 2^25 to 2^27 and all levels 2^21 to 2^23 on the laptop, 2^22 to 2^24 on the last level on the server; both bracketed, all levels at 2^22 better. Seen before choosing: these scans and every full-split score so far (the own-rule and rule-off scores of every arm, the all-level teach of c, e8, e10 and f); no full-split teach score of B16's or B64's cells. N's and carry's last-level scans are from the server queue.

Both bracketed; all levels at 2^22 better than the last level. Seen before choosing: every full-split score so far, including the teach scores of c, e8, e10, f, B16 and B64 cells; none of d's or carry's.

results.b: a with v15's rule on levels 0-5 at 2^22: the threshold re-picked on the first million bytes

decision.setting: e10's: train with Rule A on the last level and a decay of shift 10 (a memory of four training windows) in the loop; read with v15's rule on levels 0-5 at a threshold re-picked on the first million validation bytes (2^22)
decision.candidate_route: no-go: no arm with its own rule beats b; the best, B16, is -0.0205 [-0.0221, -0.0189]
caveats: One seed per arm; e10 is the best of seven trained-cell settings, whose average margin over b is 0.0085 (0.0097 for the five trained on the last level).
The shuffled control's cells (f) beat b by 0.0042 through a better base, not a larger gain from v15's rule (0.1371 against 0.1372).

By b at v15's threshold of 2^24 (1.84989), the b scored when the criteria were recorded, B16 (+0.0152) and B64 (+0.0116) with their own rules would pass criterion 1; the per-arm re-pick, recorded at 00:24 UTC before their scores (03:50 UTC), made b 0.036 stronger. B16's shuffled control gains 0.0130 over a (a ninth of B16's gain), all from its base; B16's long stream was not scored.
The full-size decay (shift 13 for windows of 2,048 bytes) keeps e10's ratio of memory to window; it is not tested on the test bed.

full_size.from: the saved state from which l2048-flat started (p-forget at 24,000 updates), with l2048-flat's settings and --plastic-levels 10 --plastic-decay-shift 13, to 90,000 updates
full_size.scored: its own rule off and v15's rule on all 11 levels at a threshold re-picked on the first million validation bytes, against l2048-flat with v15's rule at its own re-picked threshold, paired over the same streams, on both enwik8 splits and PG-19
full_size.success: ahead by more than the paired interval and by more than 0.005 on both enwik8 splits, a gain that does not shrink along the stream, and no loss on PG-19 (the full-size mark set with the study)
